citation.text_span: Reference SN-2026-0112 · Dated 8 May 2026
Northbridge Capital Markets (Canada) Inc. (the "Issuer") will issue notes (the "Notes")
in an aggregate Notional Amount of USD 7,500,000
Settlement at maturity or upon automatic early redemption is in cash, in USD.
The Trade Date is 8 May 2026
the Issue Date is 15 May 2026
the Scheduled Maturity Date is 17 May 2030
The Notes are linked to the performance of the Bloomberg Versa 10 Index (Bloomberg: BVERSA10 Index) (the "Underlying").
The Initial Level of the Underlying is 100% of its official closing level on the Trade Date
the Notes are subject to a knock-in barrier observed on the Final Valuation Date only (European observation)
at a Knock-in Level of 60% of the Initial Level
The Notes pay a conditional Coupon of 8.25% per annum, payable quarterly
The Notes pay a conditional Coupon of 8.25% per annum, payable quarterly
payable quarterly in arrears
Memory feature: if a Coupon is not paid on a Coupon Payment Date because the Coupon Condition is not satisfied, that Coupon is not lost.
Autocall Observation Dates: 10 May 2027, 8 November 2027, 8 May 2028, 8 November 2028, 8 May 2029, 8 November 2029.
if on any Autocall Observation Date the closing level of the Underlying is at or above 100% of the Initial Level
Coupon amounts accrue on a 30/360 day count basis.
Settlement at maturity or upon automatic early redemption is in cash, in USD.
Payment dates are adjusted in accordance with the Modified Following Business Day Convention.
Bloomberg Index Services Limited, authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority as a benchmark administrator
Excess Return (Type I under the Index Methodology)
Excess Return (Type I under the Index Methodology)
Volatility Target 10% per annum
Each Index Business Day, in accordance with the Index Methodology
0.50% per annum, deducted daily from the Index Value
0.02% on changes in Underlying Index units, as provided in the Index Methodology
